plain_english: Of unawakened minds, eager to cover self-standing — they cast down on the hard-to-cross, terrible wandering road.
sanskrit_cite: aprabudhadhiyas tv ete svasthitisthaganodyatāḥ | pātayanti duruttāre ghore saṃsāravartmani

plain_english: Hence ever striving for spanda-reality discerning: waking indeed, the own state soon attains.
sanskrit_cite: ataḥ satatam udyuktaḥ spandatattvaviviktaye | jāgrad eva nijam bhāvam acireṇādhigacchati

plain_english: Angry, thrilled, or what shall I do — or pondering, running: whatever step it takes, there spanda is established.
sanskrit_cite: atikruddhaḥ prahṛṣṭo vā kiṃ karomīti vā mṛśan | dhāvan va yat padaṃ gacchet tatra spandaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ

plain_english: Which state seized, whatever this one tells me — that I will do: thus resolved, he stands.
sanskrit_cite: yām avasthāṃ samālambya yad ayam mama vakṣyati | tadavaśyaṃ kariṣye 'ham iti saṃkalpya tiṣṭhati

plain_english: Her, by resorting to the upper path, moon and sun both — in suṣumnā set, brahma-egg-range left.
sanskrit_cite: tām aśrityordhvamārgeṇa candrasūryāv ubhāv api | sauṣumne 'dhvanyastamito hitvā brahmā.ṅdagocaram

plain_english: Then in that great sky, moon and sun dissolved — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered.
sanskrit_cite: tadā tasmin mahāvyomni pralīnaśaśibhāskare | sauṣuptapadavan mūḍhaḥ prabuddhaḥ syād anāvṛtaḥ
